original_fields.Applicability review notes: Directly developed for adolescents (from age 14–16) and young adults (around age 18) transitioning from paediatric to adult oncology care. Applies specifically to AYA survivors of childhood or adolescent cancers rather than those diagnosed in adult care settings. Clinic listings and care pathways are specific to Germany.
original_fields.Description excerpt: Explanation of the transition from paediatric to adult healthcare, including continuity of follow-up, preparation, growing independence, care planning and possible sources of support.

original_fields.Applicability review notes: Intended for survivors of childhood, adolescent and young-adult cancer. Lifestyle guidance is general and may require adaptation to treatment-related limitations and the individual care plan.
original_fields.Description excerpt: Survivor-oriented summary explaining health-promoting behaviours after childhood, adolescent or young-adult cancer, including activity, diet, avoiding smoking and discussing suitable lifestyle changes with professionals.
